verdict.rationale: telli ships Charlie, a built-in AI assistant that lets users build and refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze calls through natural language. An official MCP server also lets external AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex drive Charlie conversationally. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which product operations Charlie can perform and their limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.
